name: PandaDoc
description: Connect your own PandaDoc workspace to create, send, and track documents from templates or PDF uploads; manage document fields, recipients, reminders, attachments, sections, and linked objects; manage templates, forms, Content Library items, and folders; manage contacts and workspace members; manage webhooks and the product/pricing catalog; read API logs; plus bulk operations (delete/send/remind) and a workspace health audit across many documents at once. Uses your own PandaDoc API Key -- nothing is hosted or proxied by Imperal beyond the request itself.

tools.name: connect_pandadoc
tools.description: Connect your PandaDoc workspace by saving your API Key, after checking it actually works. Generate one in the Developer Dashboard (Sandbox key is free/self-serve; Production key requires PandaDoc Sales approval). This manages documents, templates, forms, contacts, webhooks, and your product catalog in your own PandaDoc workspace.

api_key.description: Your PandaDoc API Key, generated in the Developer Dashboard (Sandbox or Production).
api_key.title: Api Key

label.description: Optional friendly name for this connection (e.g. 'Sales workspace').
label.title: Label

tools.name: disconnect_pandadoc
tools.description: Disconnect a PandaDoc workspace: deletes the saved API Key. Nothing in your PandaDoc account itself is changed.

connection_id.description: Id of the connection to disconnect (from list_connections).
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected PandaDoc workspaces.

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List documents in the connected PandaDoc workspace, optionally filtered by parent template/form/folder/contact.

status.description: Filter by document status, e.g. document.draft, document.sent, document.completed.
status.title: Status

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a new PandaDoc document from a template (template_uuid + recipients) or from a publicly reachable PDF URL. Pass exactly the fields PandaDoc expects as raw JSON in payload_json (see CONNECTOR_DISCOVERY.md for the two request shapes).

payload_json.description: Raw PandaDoc Create Document request body as JSON -- either the template shape ({"template_uuid":..., "recipients":[...], "fields":{...}}) or the PDF-URL shape ({"url":..., "recipients":[...]}). See create_document_from_template / create_document_from_url for the structured alternative.
payload_json.title: Payload Json

tools.name: create_document_from_upload
tools.description: Create a new PandaDoc document by uploading a PDF/DOCX file (base64-encoded content_b64) with a name and recipients, instead of starting from a template.

content_b64.description: Base64-encoded PDF/DOCX file content to upload.
content_b64.title: Content B64

recipients_json.description: JSON array of recipients, same shape as create_document_from_template.
recipients_json.title: Recipients Json

tools.name: get_document_status
tools.description: Read one document's current status by id (draft/sent/completed/viewed/etc).

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Permanently delete a PandaDoc document. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: bulk_delete_documents
tools.description: Permanently delete several PandaDoc documents in one call, by explicit document ids. Cannot be undone.

document_ids_json.description: JSON array of explicit document ids to delete, e.g. '["id1","id2"]'.
document_ids_json.title: Document Ids Json

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing PandaDoc document (name, tags, metadata). Pass changed fields as raw JSON in fields_json.

tags_json.description: JSON array of tags to set (replaces existing tags if provided).
tags_json.title: Tags Json

tools.name: get_document_details
tools.description: Read one document in full: recipients, pricing tables, tokens, fields, and full metadata.

tools.name: send_document
tools.description: Send an existing draft document to its recipients for signing, optionally with a custom subject/message.

message.description: Message included in the send-for-signature email.
message.title: Message

silent.description: Send without notifying recipients by email.
silent.title: Silent

tools.name: change_document_status
tools.description: Move a document to a specific PandaDoc status code (e.g. mark a draft document.draft as sent). Use PandaDoc's documented numeric status codes.

status.description: Numeric target status code per PandaDoc's DocumentStatusRequestEnum (0-14).
status.title: Status

tools.name: download_document
tools.description: Download a completed/draft document's PDF content as base64.

watermark_text.description: Optional watermark text to stamp on the downloaded PDF.
watermark_text.title: Watermark Text

tools.name: get_document_esign_disclosure
tools.description: Read the eSign disclosure text shown to signers for one document.

tools.name: get_document_audit_trail
tools.description: Read the tamper-evident audit trail (who viewed/signed/declined and when) for one document.

tools.name: get_document_settings
tools.description: Read per-document settings (e.g. recipient signing order enforcement, language).

tools.name: update_document_settings
tools.description: Update per-document settings (recipient signing order enforcement, language, etc). Pass changed fields as raw JSON.

settings_json.description: JSON object of document settings fields to update.
settings_json.title: Settings Json

tools.name: move_document_to_folder
tools.description: Move a document into a different documents folder.

folder_id.description: Target document folder id, from list_document_folders.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

tools.name: get_document_ownership
tools.description: Read which workspace member currently owns a document.

tools.name: update_document_ownership
tools.description: Reassign a document to a different workspace member.

member_id.description: Workspace member id to assign as the new owner, from list_members.
member_id.title: Member Id

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List templates available in the connected PandaDoc workspace, optionally filtered by folder or tag.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Read one PandaDoc template in full -- its tags, roles, and content.

tools.name: update_template
tools.description: Update a template's tokens and/or role assignments.

tokens_json.description: Optional JSON array of token overrides.
tokens_json.title: Tokens Json

roles_json.description: Optional JSON array of role name overrides.
roles_json.title: Roles Json

tools.name: delete_template
tools.description: Permanently delete a PandaDoc template. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: duplicate_template
tools.description: Duplicate an existing PandaDoc template -- same content/roles, a new id.

tools.name: list_forms
tools.description: List forms available in the connected PandaDoc workspace.

tools.name: get_form
tools.description: Read one PandaDoc form's field schema in full.

tools.name: list_content_library_items
tools.description: List Content Library items (reusable blocks/clauses) in the connected PandaDoc workspace.

tools.name: get_content_library_item
tools.description: Read one Content Library item in full.

item_id.description: Content Library item id, from list_content_library_items.
item_id.title: Item Id

tools.name: list_document_folders
tools.description: List folders used to organize documents in the connected PandaDoc workspace.

parent_uuid.description: Optional parent folder id to list children of.
parent_uuid.title: Parent Uuid

tools.name: create_document_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder to organize documents.

name.description: Name for the new documents folder.
name.title: Name

parent_uuid.description: Optional parent folder id to nest this folder under.
parent_uuid.title: Parent Uuid

tools.name: rename_document_folder
tools.description: Rename an existing document folder.

folder_id.description: Documents folder id to rename, from list_document_folders.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

tools.name: list_template_folders
tools.description: List folders used to organize templates in the connected PandaDoc workspace.

parent_uuid.description: Optional parent folder id to list children of.
parent_uuid.title: Parent Uuid

tools.name: create_template_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder to organize templates.

name.description: Name for the new templates folder.
name.title: Name

parent_uuid.description: Optional parent folder id to nest this folder under.
parent_uuid.title: Parent Uuid

tools.name: rename_template_folder
tools.description: Rename an existing template folder.

folder_id.description: Templates folder id to rename, from list_template_folders.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

tools.name: get_document_fields
tools.description: Read the merge/form field values currently set on a document.

tools.name: update_document_fields
tools.description: Update merge/form field values on a document that is still in draft.

fields_json.description: JSON array of {field_id, value} objects to update.
fields_json.title: Fields Json

tools.name: list_document_recipients
tools.description: List the recipients, approvers, and CC'd contacts on a document.

tools.name: add_document_recipient
tools.description: Add a contact as a recipient, approver, or CC on a document, by contact id.

contact_id.description: Contact id to add as recipient/approver/CC, from list_contacts.
contact_id.title: Contact Id

tools.name: update_document_recipient
tools.description: Update a recipient's details on a document still in draft (e.g. fix a mistyped email).

recipient_id.description: Recipient id to update, from list_document_recipients.
recipient_id.title: Recipient Id

fields_json.description: JSON object of recipient fields to change.
fields_json.title: Fields Json

tools.name: delete_document_recipient
tools.description: Remove a recipient from a document still in draft. Cannot be undone.

recipient_id.description: Recipient id to remove, from list_document_recipients.
recipient_id.title: Recipient Id

tools.name: send_manual_reminder
tools.description: Send an immediate one-off reminder email to a document's pending recipients.

tools.name: get_document_auto_reminder_settings
tools.description: Read a document's automatic reminder schedule settings.

tools.name: update_document_auto_reminder_settings
tools.description: Update a document's automatic reminder schedule (turn on/off, change cadence).

enabled.description: Turn automatic reminders on or off.
enabled.title: Enabled

settings_json.description: JSON object of auto-reminder schedule fields.
settings_json.title: Settings Json

tools.name: get_document_auto_reminder_status
tools.description: Read whether a document's automatic reminders are currently active.

tools.name: list_document_attachments
tools.description: List files attached to a document (separate from the document's own content).

tools.name: add_document_attachment
tools.description: Attach a file (fetched from a publicly reachable URL) to a document.

file_url.description: Publicly reachable HTTPS URL of the file to attach.
file_url.title: File Url

name.description: Optional display name for the attachment.
name.title: Name

tools.name: delete_document_attachment
tools.description: Permanently remove an attachment from a document. Cannot be undone.

attachment_id.description: Attachment id to remove, from list_document_attachments.
attachment_id.title: Attachment Id

tools.name: list_document_sections
tools.description: List the content sections/bundles that make up a multi-section document.

tools.name: add_document_section_from_template
tools.description: Add a new content section to a document, built from an existing template.

template_uuid.description: Template id to append as a new section/bundle.
template_uuid.title: Template Uuid

name.description: Optional name for the new section.
name.title: Name

tools.name: list_linked_objects
tools.description: List CRM/external objects (e.g. a HubSpot deal or Salesforce opportunity) linked to a document.

tools.name: link_object_to_document
tools.description: Link an external CRM object (provider + entity type + id) to a document.

provider.description: CRM/provider name the object belongs to (e.g. 'salesforce', 'hubspot').
provider.title: Provider

external_id.description: The external record id being linked to this document.
external_id.title: External Id

tools.name: unlink_object_from_document
tools.description: Remove a previously linked external CRM object from a document.

linked_object_id.description: Linked-object id to remove, from list_linked_objects.
linked_object_id.title: Linked Object Id

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (external people you send documents to) saved in the connected PandaDoc workspace.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Create a new contact (a person you can add as a document recipient/approver) in the connected PandaDoc workspace.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing PandaDoc contact.

contact_id.description: Contact id to update, from list_contacts.
contact_id.title: Contact Id

fields_json.description: JSON object of contact fields to change.
fields_json.title: Fields Json

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Permanently delete a contact from the connected PandaDoc workspace. Documents already sent to them are not affected.

contact_id.description: Contact id to delete, from list_contacts.
contact_id.title: Contact Id

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List the members (users) of the connected PandaDoc workspace.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List webhook subscriptions configured on this PandaDoc workspace.

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: Read one webhook subscription's full configuration by id.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Subscribe to a PandaDoc event (e.g. document_state_changed, recipient_completed) -- PandaDoc will POST to your URL whenever it happens.

name.description: Display name for this webhook subscription.
name.title: Name

url.description: HTTPS endpoint PandaDoc will POST events to.
url.title: Url

active.description: Whether the subscription is active immediately.
active.title: Active

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Update an existing webhook subscription's name, URL, triggers, and/or active state. Only given fields change.

name.description: New display name, leave blank to keep current.
name.title: Name

url.description: New HTTPS endpoint, leave blank to keep current.
url.title: Url

triggers_csv.description: New comma-separated trigger events, leave blank to keep current.
triggers_csv.title: Triggers Csv

active.description: Whether the subscription should be active.
active.title: Active

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Permanently remove a webhook subscription. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_webhook_event_types
tools.description: List the event types PandaDoc can notify a webhook subscription about (e.g. document_state_changed, recipient_completed, template_created).

tools.name: list_catalog_items
tools.description: List products/services in the connected PandaDoc pricing catalog.

tools.name: create_catalog_item
tools.description: Create a new product/service in the connected PandaDoc pricing catalog, so it can be added to documents/quotes as a priced line item.

price.description: Unit price (as a decimal string, e.g. '199.00').
price.title: Price

tools.name: get_catalog_item
tools.description: Read one product/service catalog item in full.

tools.name: update_catalog_item
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing catalog item (price, title, SKU, etc). Only given fields change.

fields_json.description: JSON object of catalog item fields to change.
fields_json.title: Fields Json

tools.name: delete_catalog_item
tools.description: Permanently delete a product/service from the pricing catalog. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_api_logs
tools.description: List recent API request logs for the connected PandaDoc workspace -- useful for debugging integration issues.

tools.name: bulk_send_documents
tools.description: Send several draft PandaDoc documents in one call, by explicit document ids. Continues past per-item failures and reports which succeeded/failed.

document_ids_json.description: JSON array of explicit draft document ids to send, e.g. '["id1","id2"]'.
document_ids_json.title: Document Ids Json

subject.description: Email subject line applied to every send.
subject.title: Subject

message.description: Email message applied to every send.
message.title: Message

silent.description: Send without notifying recipients by email.
silent.title: Silent

tools.name: bulk_send_manual_reminders
tools.description: Send a manual reminder for several PandaDoc documents in one call, by explicit document ids. Continues past per-item failures and reports which succeeded/failed.

document_ids_json.description: JSON array of explicit document ids to remind, e.g. '["id1","id2"]'.
document_ids_json.title: Document Ids Json

message.description: Reminder message applied to every document.
message.title: Message

tools.name: audit_workspace_health
tools.description: Build one aggregated health report across recent documents in the connected PandaDoc workspace: status breakdown (draft/sent/viewed/completed/declined/expired), overdue unsigned documents, and documents with no assigned owner -- a value-add report PandaDoc's own API does not provide directly.

sample_size.description: How many recent documents to sample for the audit (max 100).
sample_size.title: Sample Size

secrets.name: pandadoc_connections
secrets.description: Your connected PandaDoc workspaces -- stored as a JSON array, one entry per workspace, each with its own API Key and an optional friendly label. Managed through connect_pandadoc / disconnect_pandadoc -- you should not need to edit this directly.
